verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same flaws. The white label frame that held the brand text in the original now sits empty in the middle of the banner, with stray divider rules inside it, while all the text sits outside it on the beige background. 'SKINCARE' hangs off LAVANDER's top-right like a superscript, and the illustrations are shrunk into a row of tiny separate icons with uneven gaps, so the original's composed illustration scene is lost.
